questions.q: My kids ___ playing in the garden when it started to rain.
questions.explainRo: Past continuous la plural: were + -ing (my kids = they).

questions.q: At 7 a.m. yesterday, I ___ for the train.
questions.explainRo: Acțiune în desfășurare la o oră din trecut: I was + -ing (nu uita de was).

questions.q: My laptop was very slow, so I ___ it. Now it works fine.
questions.explainRo: Restart = a reporni un calculator sau un program.

questions.q: I couldn't join the video call because my internet ___ wasn't working.
questions.explainRo: Connection = conexiune; fără conexiune la internet nu poți intra în apel.

questions.audio: My laptop crashed while I was giving a presentation.
answers: My laptop crashed while I was giving a presentation.
questions.ro: Mi s-a blocat laptopul în timp ce țineam o prezentare.
questions.explainRo: While + past continuous pentru acțiunea lungă, iar crashed (past simple) este acțiunea scurtă.

questions.q: We were walking along the beach when it suddenly ___ (start) to rain.
questions.explainRo: Acțiunea scurtă care o întrerupe pe cea lungă stă la past simple: started.
Întrebarea la past continuous: Were + you + -ing, iar acțiunea scurtă (called) e la past simple.

questions.q: Sorry, I ___ (not / listen). Can you repeat the question?
questions.explainRo: Negativul la past continuous: wasn't + verb-ing.

questions.q: The teacher asked a question. I ___ the answer, but I didn't say anything.
questions.explainRo: Know nu se folosește de obicei cu -ing, așa că spunem I knew, nu „I was knowing”.

questions.ro: S-a stins lumina în timp ce mâncam.
questions.explainRo: While + past continuous pentru fundal (we were eating), iar acțiunea scurtă stă la past simple (went off).

questions.q: At midnight, I was working, and my cat ___ (sleep) on my keyboard.
questions.explainRo: Două acțiuni lungi în același timp stau amândouă la past continuous: was sleeping.

questions.ro: Ce făceai când a început furtuna?
answers: What were you doing when the storm started?
What were you doing when the storm began?
questions.explainRo: „Ce făceai” (acțiune în desfășurare) = What were you doing, iar „a început” (acțiune scurtă) = started, la past simple.
